images.prompt: Wide shot of a massive industrial transformable mecha hovering in space against a swirling nebula, with wear patterns, exposed mechanical joints and battle-scarred armor. Glowing orange thruster exhausts and a blue plasma weapon, asteroid debris drifting nearby.

Medium tracking shot of a sleek fighter-mecha hybrid banking through a dense asteroid field firing energy bursts, transforming mid-flight from streamlined fighter to humanoid mecha. Orange muzzle flashes light the asteroid surfaces, debris cascades from impacts.

Close dramatic angle on a transformation sequence as fighter wings retract into mecha shoulder armor: hydraulic pistons, exposed cabling, articulated joints, orange warning lights, a helmet visor reflecting holographic targeting, distant planetary rings.

Portrait of a pilot in a full armored environmental suit seated in an industrial mecha cockpit, visor reflecting holographic displays, gloved hands on weathered controls, exposed machinery around the seat, orange status lights and blue readouts.

Wide establishing shot of a frontier star system. In the foreground, a cratered grey moon with a sprawling armored fortress base built into its surface, lit by orange floodlights. Above it a huge banded gas giant with rings fills half the sky. Along the lower edge curves the glowing horizon of a blue ocean planet. A violet nebula and drifting asteroid debris in the black void. A boxy grey supply mothership with a flat landing deck hangs in orbit, and a small grey fighter jet with orange thruster flames streaks down toward the fortress.
